environment.description: Identical Celery worker deployment on ECS Fargate with PyPy 7.3 runtime. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY action override to BLOCK for bodies > 3KB, (2) a custom rule group 'payload-entropy-gate' that uses a regex pattern set matching base64-encoded zlib magic bytes (eJy/eNq/eNo patterns) combined with a byte_match_statement on the decoded body checking for pickle opcode sequences (\x80\x04\x95, \x63, \x71) with positional_constraint CONTAINS, action BLOCK, (3) rate-based rule limiting /api/v2/jobs to 50 requests per 5-minute window per source IP. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule group 'payload-entropy-gate' has non-zero BlockedRequests in production.

waf_rules.name: payload-entropy-gate
statements: byte_match body contains \x80\x04\x95 OR \x63 OR \x71 (pickle opcodes)
